description: Adjust screen brightness level in Display settings
qna_description: Controls the brightness of your Galaxy screen. Drag the slider to increase or decrease brightness.

description: Toggle adaptive brightness to auto-adjust screen brightness based on ambient light
qna_description: Adaptive brightness automatically adjusts screen brightness based on the ambient light level around you.

description: Set the screen timeout duration before the display turns off automatically
qna_description: Screen timeout controls how long the screen stays on when idle. Shorter timeout saves battery.

description: Change screen resolution for display quality vs battery trade-off
qna_description: Screen resolution determines display quality. Higher resolution uses more battery.

description: Set screen refresh rate - higher refresh rate gives smoother scrolling but uses more power
message: Open Motion smoothness / refresh rate settings
qna_description: Refresh rate determines how many times per second the screen updates. 60Hz saves battery, 120Hz is smoother.

description: Enable Eye comfort shield (blue light filter) to reduce eye strain
message: Open Eye comfort shield / blue light filter
qna_description: Eye comfort shield reduces blue light emission which can improve sleep quality and reduce eye fatigue at night.

description: Enable dark mode or night mode across the system
message: Open Dark mode / Night mode settings
qna_description: Dark mode switches the system UI and supported apps to dark backgrounds, reducing eye strain and battery on AMOLED screens.

description: Configure navigation bar layout, type, and gesture navigation settings
message: Open Navigation bar settings under Display
qna_description: Navigation bar settings let you choose between button navigation and swipe gesture navigation, and customize the layout.

description: Adjust display size and text size for readability
message: Open Display size and font settings
qna_description: Display size and font settings let you make items on the screen larger or smaller.

description: View detailed battery usage statistics by app and system component
qna_description: Battery usage shows which apps and processes are consuming the most battery power.

description: Enable Power saving mode to extend battery life by limiting performance and features
qna_description: Power saving mode reduces battery consumption by limiting CPU speed, turning off sync, and reducing screen brightness.

description: Enable Ultra power saving mode for maximum battery conservation in emergency situations
qna_description: Ultra power saving mode severely limits the device to only essential functions to maximize remaining battery life.

description: Manage battery optimization settings for individual apps to prevent excessive background drain
qna_description: Battery optimization puts apps to sleep when not in use to reduce background battery consumption.

description: Enable battery protection to limit charging to 85% for long-term battery health
qna_description: Battery protection limits maximum charge to 85% to extend the overall lifespan of your battery.

description: Enable Adaptive charging to slow charge overnight and reduce battery degradation
qna_description: Adaptive charging learns your routine and slows charging to protect battery health during overnight charging.

description: Manage Wi-Fi networks, connections, and advanced settings
qna_description: Wi-Fi settings let you connect to wireless networks, manage saved networks, and configure advanced options.

description: Manage Bluetooth connections, paired devices, and visibility settings
qna_description: Bluetooth settings let you pair and manage wireless accessories and other devices.

description: Control mobile data usage, data limits, and network preferences
qna_description: Mobile data settings let you control cellular data usage, set limits, and manage network connections.

description: Run device care optimization to improve performance and free up memory
qna_description: Device Care checks battery, storage, memory, and device security, and provides optimization recommendations.

description: View and manage device storage, clear cached data and unused files
qna_description: Storage settings show how your device storage is being used and let you free up space by deleting cached files.

description: View RAM usage and manage background apps consuming memory
message: Open RAM and device care memory settings
qna_description: RAM management lets you see which apps are using memory and clear background processes to improve performance.

description: Adjust volume levels for ringtone, media, notifications, and system sounds
qna_description: Volume settings let you independently control media volume, ringtone volume, notification volume, and system sound volume.

description: Configure Do Not Disturb mode to silence calls, alerts, and notifications
qna_description: Do Not Disturb silences calls and notifications. You can allow exceptions for alarms or specific contacts.

description: View all installed apps and manage permissions, storage, and notifications per app
qna_description: App management lets you view all apps, force stop apps, clear cache, manage permissions, and uninstall apps.

description: Set default apps for browser, messaging, phone, and other functions
qna_description: Default apps settings let you choose which app handles browser links, calls, messages, and other common actions.

description: Enable video stabilization (OIS) to reduce camera shake during recording
qna_description: Video stabilization reduces blur and shake in videos. Advanced stabilization crops slightly but significantly smooths footage.

description: Enable grid lines in camera viewfinder for better composition
message: Open Camera grid and composition settings
qna_description: Camera grid lines overlay a rule-of-thirds grid to help frame your shots.

description: Enable QR code scanning directly from the camera viewfinder
message: Open Camera QR code scanner settings
qna_description: QR code scanning lets you scan codes directly in the camera app without opening a separate scanner app.

description: Access developer options for advanced performance tuning and debugging
qna_description: Developer options provide advanced settings for app debugging, performance tuning, and system behavior.

description: Check for and install system software updates
qna_description: Software update checks for the latest One UI firmware and security patches for your Galaxy device.

description: Reset all device settings to factory defaults without erasing data
qna_description: Reset settings restores all device settings to their default values without deleting your apps or data.

description: Perform a full factory data reset - WARNING: erases all data on device
qna_description: Factory reset erases all data and restores the device to its original state. This cannot be undone.

description: Increase touch sensitivity for use with screen protectors or gloves
qna_description: Touch sensitivity settings improve screen response when using a screen protector or thin gloves.

description: Enable wireless power sharing to charge accessories or other phones
qna_description: Wireless PowerShare lets you charge Qi-compatible devices by placing them on the back of your Galaxy phone.

description: Set up and manage mobile hotspot for internet sharing
qna_description: Mobile hotspot shares your cellular data connection with other devices via Wi-Fi.

description: Access accessibility features including display size, text, hearing, and interaction settings
qna_description: Accessibility settings provide features to assist users with visual, hearing, and motor impairments.

description: Configure Always On Display to show clock and notifications while screen is off
qna_description: Always On Display shows the clock, calendar, and notification icons while the screen is off, using minimal battery.

description: Control which apps can refresh content in the background to reduce battery and data usage
qna_description: Background app activity controls whether apps can check for new content when not actively used.

description: Manage location access permissions and location accuracy settings
qna_description: Location settings control which apps can access your GPS and network location data.

description: Configure Game Booster settings for optimized gaming performance
qna_description: Game Booster optimizes your phone for gaming by blocking notifications and allocating more resources to games.

description: Change the default notification sound and vibration pattern
qna_description: Notification sound settings let you choose the default alert sound and vibration pattern for notifications.

description: Set date, time, and time zone settings manually or automatically
qna_description: Date and time settings let you set the current date, time, and time zone, or sync them automatically.

description: Configure screensaver that activates when device is charging or docked
qna_description: Screensaver displays photos, animations, or a clock when your phone is charging or connected to a dock.

description: Enable or disable NFC for contactless payments and data transfer
qna_description: NFC enables contactless payments via Samsung Pay and short-range data sharing with NFC-compatible devices.

description: Configure fingerprint, face recognition, and other biometric security options
qna_description: Biometrics settings let you register fingerprints, set up face recognition, and configure their security level.

description: Limit the number of background processes to improve performance (developer option)
message: Open Background process limit in Developer options
qna_description: Background process limit restricts how many processes can run in the background simultaneously.

description: Change camera photo format between HEIF and JPEG
qna_description: HEIF photos use less storage space than JPEG but may not be compatible with all apps.

description: Toggle Airplane mode to disable all wireless communications
qna_description: Airplane mode disables all wireless communications including cellular, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth.

description: Adjust display color mode between Vivid, Natural, and custom color profiles
qna_description: Color mode settings let you choose between Vivid colors for more saturation or Natural colors for accurate color reproduction.

description: Restart device in Safe mode to diagnose third-party app issues
message: Information about restarting in Safe mode
qna_description: Safe mode starts your Galaxy with only pre-installed Samsung apps to help identify if a third-party app is causing problems.
